intro: The Bezel turns everyday meals into warm moments. With its glass top and Terra base, it creates a cozy stage where compact dining feels stylish, intimate, and always connected.

features.title: Space for larger celebrations
features.text: Generous tabletop seats eight comfortably, perfect for extended families, festivals, or special occasions.

features.title: Glass top with unique display space
features.text: Spray-painted glass reveals a subtle showcase beneath, letting you style décor or keepsakes while keeping meals practical.

features.title: Shelf that keeps everything handy
features.text: The built-in shelf keeps utensils, napkins, or snacks within reach, so you pour, prep, and host without leaving the conversation or hunting inside cabinets.

features.title: Strong frame for daily durability
features.text: Square metal tubes in black hold the table steady, ensuring strength and stability for everyday use.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
